name: decider-31b-fp8
readout: next-token logits of the option letters at the answer position, one forward pass, nothing generated

limits.truncation: head/tail of the state when over the limit; never refused

calibration_fit.on: own generated decision items only, never JevBench items: raw (T=1) outputs taken from this exact serving path (vLLM 0.31.0, FP8, H100 80GB), on a mixture of frozen-model-hard holdouts (170 + 210 items) and easier dev items (649) chosen so that per-type accuracy matches the difficulty the sealed pool is believed to have (choice: accuracy 0.878 from the official competence of the same frozen recipe, deck-31B; noul: 0.925 = public accuracy minus the ~2-point public-sealed gap; score: temperature fixed at 1 because its competence uses the expected level)
calibration_fit.objective: per type: chance-corrected competence + the JevBench calibration term
calibration_fit.public_check_not_fitted_on: 231 public items through the official CLI on the H100 (FP8): 213/231 correct, 0 failures

quantization: fp8 (vLLM on-the-fly quantisation of the pinned bf16 checkpoint; the measured and calibrated configuration)
